purpose: Two focused sessions: first audit recorded one-step decisions and exact-state paired slider responses; second only if the first demonstrates consequential ambiguity.
score: absolute predicted image-derived y error after one action plus 0.001 times absolute y action, in meters; argmin chooses first candidate on exact tie
nominal_predictor: predicted object y displacement equals requested y displacement
oracle: separate MjData and environment; mj_copyData copies full state including actuator, warmstart, solver and time; diagnostic only
decision_rule: Proceed only if a feasible matched state shows different uniquely preferred candidate actions with oracle score gap >= one image pixel (0.0023 m) and the distinction persists under independent natural histories; otherwise close this guided-task investigation without sequential-policy tuning.
